subject: CHEMISTRY
purpose: Control fresh challenge generation so transfer demand rises without adding unapproved chemistry, relying on arithmetic ugliness, or faking official provenance.
official_source_rule: Official exam/year/question attribution is allowed only when an exact official source is verified.
generated_question_label_rule: Fresh items influenced by competition archives must be described as generated/original competitive-style practice, never as official past questions.
curriculum_boundary: Competitive material can change problem design and reasoning demand, not Chemistry curricular authority.
